newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics says Chabraja to be CEO.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics says Chabraja to be CEO.

text.p: General Dynamics Corp said on Monday Nicholas Chabraja would be named chairman and chief executive next year, succeeding James Mellor, who plans to retire from those positions on May 31, 1997.
The company also said Chabraja, who most recently was executive vice president, was named vice chairman.
Mellor will remain on the board after he retires, General Dynamics said.
The company, which makes nuclear submarines, surface combatant ships and armored vehicles, has annualized sales of about $4 billion.
